annotation.title_clean: 民政部 全国老龄办 中国老龄协会关于深入开展特殊困难老年人探访关爱服务的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice of the Ministry of Civil Affairs, National Office on Aging and China Association on Aging on Further Carrying Out Visiting and Care Services for Elderly People in Special Difficulty
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 民政部; 全国老龄办; 中国老龄协会
annotation.summary_en: Chinese national notice directing localities to run visiting and care services for elderly people in special difficulty (living alone, disabled, etc.), setting targets through 2028, visit frequency, workforce, funding and data reporting. It only briefly encourages smart monitoring devices; it has no AI or robot governance content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Key at-risk elderly are to be visited at least once every two weeks.
Targets: full rollout by end-2026, county-level lists by 2027, routine long-term mechanisms by 2028.
Workforce drawn from township and community staff, volunteers, public-interest posts and social organisations.
Multi-channel funding and data reporting via the 'One Form' system by December 2026.
Encourages smart call systems, smart meters and health monitoring devices where feasible.
